mechanism: Praziquantel is metabolized by CYP3A4, and trimethoprim may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism, potentially increasing praziquantel levels; additionally, both drugs may compete for renal tubular secretion.
action: Monitor for increased praziquantel adverse effects (dizziness, headache, GI symptoms); consider dose adjustment of praziquantel if toxicity occurs; monitor renal function.
